title: spec(automation): a read-only `record` screen field: a flow screen shows a record it created, by display name, as a link to the record page (#25872 ruling B)
body:
Filed by seat `domain:ui#1` (seat post #25966) · `os-steve` · session `session_017iXjUm1rujwDk7f3KT1Pkk`, carrying out the maintainer's ruling on #25872. ⛔ Not a claim; `domain:spec` grades and owns it.

Ruling-ref: 6422899013 (https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/25872#issuecomment-6422899013). Batch #401 item 4, letter **B**, maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-26T17:29Z. The substance is the `domain:ui` seat 2 analysis 6419689832.

## Business reason

A screen flow that creates records ends today with a toast, and nothing points at what it created. HotCRM's lead conversion creates an account, a contact and optionally an opportunity. The rep has to know to open the lead's Related tab. The ruled shape lets the author put a last screen of "created records" cards, each linking to its record page. hotcrm#2285 is blocked on it.

## The contract half (this card)

These are the ruling's execution parameters, adopted in the same stroke:
- A new `ScreenFieldConfigSchema` `type` member (`packages/spec/src/automation/builtin-node-config.zod.ts`, `type` at :913). The dev proposes the name; `record` is suggested.
- On that member, `reference` (object name) and `defaultValue` (a `FlowValueSlotSchema` value slot that evaluates to the id) are **required**.
- `required`, `options`, `placeholder`, `min` and `max` are **refused** on it.
- On resume, a value submitted under that field's name is **refused loudly** and never bound to a flow variable. This is the engine rule in `screen-input-contract.ts`.
- `visibleWhen` works as usual. An empty id renders "—".
- Declarations: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`, `@objectstack/spec` minor.

## The consumer half (#25872, `domain:ui`)

The console's `ScreenFieldInput` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ScreenView.tsx`) gains a branch that renders the record's display name (ADR-0079 `nameField`, through `LookupField`'s readonly branch) as a link to the record page. It also needs a `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` section and one dogfood proof: two created records shown and linked, and a resume carrying the field's value refused.

## Landing shape (to agree with the spec seat)

The ruling allows **one PR across spec, engine and console** closing both cards, in the shape of the landed precedent #26134 (the `file` screen field, #25801: +959/−48, 14 files). That way declared = enforced ships in one release. If the spec seat prefers its own PR, the console branch lands in the same release. The `domain:ui` seat 1 card thread for #25872 is ready to build the one-PR shape on the spec seat's word.

## Duplicate check

`search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, "screen field read-only record reference type ScreenFieldConfigSchema record link flow end screen": only #25872 (this card's consumer half) and closed neighbours (#25801 `file`, #17306, #14945). No open contract card.
